title: Power weight inequalities for spherical maximal functions
summary: This paper is about spherical maximal functions with general dilation sets acting on functions in weighted $L^p(|x|^α)$ spaces. Aside from endpoint cases, a complete description of the allowable ranges of $p$, $α$ is given in terms of the Legendre--Assouad function of the dilation set. This settles, up to endpoints, an open problem of Duoandikoetxea and Seijo.
